fact: The Somalia Federal Ministry of Health poster says DHIS2 functions as the national HMIS for aggregate reporting in Somalia.

The poster says RAAD (BAMNI), the national primary-care electronic health record deployed in 111 facilities across six states, automatically generates DHIS2-compliant aggregate reports from routine care records.
The CaafimaadPlus Consortium says its C+ Digitalized Data System, operating in over 40 facilities across 9 regions, pushes data in real time into the government's DHIS2 platform.
HISP UiO says DHIS2 serves as the backbone of Somalia's national health management information system, supporting data collection across disease surveillance, HIV monitoring and immunization.
HISP UiO says Somalia has adopted DHIS2 Tracker for disease surveillance, HIV monitoring and immunization records within its DHIS2-based health management information system.
